bpmn:participant.name: BPMN-05 | Subscription Progress Update and Cycle Completion

bpmn:process.name: Subscription Progress Update and Cycle Completion
bpmn:process.bpmn:documentation: Sources: docs/proposed-bpmn-catalog.md BPMN-05; Chapters/Kitchen406 - Capstone Paper.md SRS 4.8.3 FR-SUB-04,16-17; supporting FR-SUB-03,15,18 and NFR-REL-03,05-06. Prototype: index.html and linked app/subscription-state.js B.sync and app/owner-subscriptions.js. SRS governs differences. Vertical flow; internal responsibility swimlanes in one Kitchen406 pool. References describe ownership and handoffs, not invocation. BPMN-04 establishes the four fulfillment records, original apportioned product amounts and single prepaid purchase link; BPMN-16 owns independent preparing-owner allocations; BPMN-18/20 own actual completion; BPMN-43 owns report generation and applies FR-SUB-16-17 (Fulfilled sales only for completed fulfillments, excluding delivery fees, and prepaid payment counted once). BPMN-34 owns customer status inquiry; BPMN-23 owns authorized reversal. None is rerun by this process. No call activity is needed because BPMN-05 invokes no other catalog process. Local reliability constraints remain here: serialize updates or check record versions; on concurrent change reread and recalculate; save counts and cycle status atomically; on failure preserve prior state and retain event for retry. Repeated events must not duplicate counts, sales or payments. Retain original amounts, allocations and payment links; do not reactivate cancelled or inconsistent subscriptions automatically. This descriptive diagram ends with progress saved, not production, delivery, reporting, notification or renewal.

bpmn:startEvent.name: Completion received from BPMN-18 or BPMN-20
bpmn:startEvent.bpmn:documentation: BPMN-18 owns pickup completion; BPMN-20 owns courier completion. Input: saved subscription ID, fulfillment ID and actual completion timestamp. These processes have already completed the fulfillment; do not invoke them again.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Read completed fulfillment and subscription
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Read the authoritative completed fulfillment and its paid subscription with four linked fulfillments established by BPMN-04. Validate linkage and saved completion status. Invalid or inconsistent input preserves prior state and is logged for recovery; it does not advance. Completion eligibility and timestamp recording belong to BPMN-18/20.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Recalculate completed and remaining counts
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-SUB-04; NFR-REL-05: completed = count of distinct linked fulfillments currently completed; remaining = 4 - completed. Validate counts within 0..4. Recalculate using current source records so duplicate or out-of-order events cannot decrement twice. Deferred fulfillments retain their identity and count once.

bpmn:exclusiveGateway.name: All four complete?
bpmn:exclusiveGateway.bpmn:documentation: Use the current completed count, never elapsed weeks or the original final scheduled date.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Save progress; retain Active cycle
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Completed count is below four. Persist counts and Active status together; retain remaining commitments. Apply the shared reliability controls documented at process level.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Save progress; close cycle as Completed
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Completed count is four; remaining is zero. Persist counts and Completed status together. Apply the shared reliability controls documented at process level. No automatic renewal or additional payment.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Cycle remains active
bpmn:endEvent.bpmn:documentation: Output: updated completed/remaining counts and Active status. Later fulfillment execution follows its own journey processes.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Four-fulfillment cycle complete
bpmn:endEvent.bpmn:documentation: Output: completed = 4, remaining = 0, status = Completed. This ends the prepaid cycle.
